narrative:
Inventory Optimization Analysis for Material PL1__MFD8090A:

DEMAND PROFILE: The material exhibits a intermittent/lumpy demand pattern with CV=2.07. 
Mean daily demand is 75.18 units with 39.9% non-zero days.
No significant trend detected.

LEAD TIME: Average lead time is 0.44 days with 98.81% variability (unstable stability).
Effective lead time (mean + 1σ) is 0.87 days.

BUFFER STRATEGY: At 95% service level, the required safety stock is 178 units.
The dominant risk factor is demand variability (91% of variance).
Demand variability drives buffer requirements.

ORDER POLICY: EOQ analysis recommends an order quantity of 747 units (vs MOQ 112).
Reorder point is 244 units. Expected review cycle is 10 days.

COST IMPACT: The optimized policy reduces total annual cost from $8579.31 to $3118.90,
saving $5460.40 annually (63.6% reduction).
This is achieved primarily by reducing ordering frequency from 168 to 25 orders per year.

SAFETY LEAD TIME: Current SAP safety lead time is 3.0 days. 
Recommended safety lead time is 2.37 days.
Action: DECREASE safety lead time parameter.
